purpose: Prospectively declared annotation sensitivity using all frozen October 15 captured histories
frequency_definition: For each version add its declared weight once to every physical artifact in the union of captured alternative-producer dependency ancestry; use max(1, total) as the original adapter does

targets_only.description: Only requested model and prediction physical identities

preprocessing_only.description: Only transformer fit and transform and feature union physical identities; split membership is excluded

hyppo_eligibility_adapter: Set ineligible physical nodes to native raw type without altering the pinned ranking functions; mandatory roots remain retained and paid
helix_scope: All eligibility only and no frequency weighting because those are not parameters of the tested published decision rule; sweep nonuniform cost profiles and read speed and event tie order
scoring: Unweighted exact version/scenario structural coverage under the identical declared fault sets; report declared weighted workload coverage separately
physical_accounting: Account selected bytes and budgets from each original immutable captured graph rather than the cost annotation proxy
exclusions: No exclusions based on outcome; missing declared captures cause an explicit failure rather than a smaller successful matrix
